title: Cafe Disco
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael creates a Cafe Disco to encourage socializing at work, leading to various interactions among the staff. Erin wins an art contest, and Jim and Pam plan their wedding. Phyllis injures her back during a dance at Cafe Disco, and Dwight discusses his plans involving exotic oils and animals. The episode features humorous conflicts and character moments centered around the new social space.
